description: This file defines and configures an Axios instance for making HTTP requests to a backend API in a React project. It sets base URL, default headers, and interceptors to attach authentication tokens and handle errors.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates a new Axios instance with specified configuration.

methods.name: api.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to attach the auth token if available.

methods.name: api.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor to handle errors and pass successful responses.
